steps.en: Pick the folder whose stack matches yours from the README's difficulty tiers
steps.zh: 从 README 的难度分档里挑一个技术栈和你相近的文件夹
steps.code: Beginner Projects · Intermediate Projects · Advanced Projects

steps.en: Names the model, framework, vector store and vendor APIs that folder wires together
steps.zh: 写明这个文件夹接了哪个模型、框架、向量库和厂商 API

steps.en: Put your API keys in .env and install that folder's own dependencies
steps.zh: 把 API key 填进 .env，装上这个文件夹自己的依赖

steps.en: Start the demo app or open its notebook
steps.zh: 启动演示应用，或打开它的 notebook

steps.en: Runs the whole chain in one place: retrieve, call the model or agents, show the answer
steps.zh: 在一处跑通整条链：检索、调模型或智能体、把答案显示出来

steps.en: Lift the glue code you need into your project and pin its versions yourself
steps.zh: 把需要的胶水代码搬进自己的项目，版本自己锁定

value.en: You see model, framework, vector store and vendor API working together in one running file instead of stitching four sets of docs
value.zh: 不用再自己把四家文档拼起来——模型、框架、向量库和厂商 API 在一个能跑的文件里接好了

sources: README.md → "Projects by Difficulty" with headings "🟢 Beginner Projects", "🟡 Intermediate Projects", "🔴 Advanced Projects" (code value = those headings without emoji)
graphiti-mcp/README.md → "We use:" list; agentic_rag/README.md → "Get API Keys" (FireCrawl); build-code-harness/README.md → E2B / CrewAI / OpenRouter list
52 top-level folders ship a .env.example (git tree, 2026-10-05); "cp .env.example .env" appears verbatim in 7 folder READMEs; "uv sync" in 47 folder READMEs (e.g. build-code-harness/README.md)
"streamlit run app.py" appears verbatim in 40 folder READMEs (e.g. audio-analysis-toolkit, biotech-agentic-analyst); simple-rag-workflow/README.md → "Run the Jupyter notebook workflow.ipynb"
Root README → "Examples to implement, adapt, and scale in your projects"; per-folder requirements are often unpinned (github-rag 0/10, multimodal-rag-assemblyai 0/16 pinned)
